statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. NQ is closed for the weekend; no live one-way price path is observable.
recommendation: Tail remains below the block threshold. Weekend geopolitical risk is reflected primarily in Stress until live price discovery resumes.
headline: Weekend closure keeps Tail low while geopolitical Stress remains extreme
body: NQ is closed, so weekend sanctions, Hormuz disruption and Russia-Ukraine escalation cannot be treated as observed Nasdaq trend structure. Conditional risk rises narrowly into the Sunday Globex reopening, where gap behavior and retracement quality become the key evidence.

lookbackSummary: All 24 prior clock-hour slots are available from previously published ChatGPT assessments. Tail stayed at 16% through Saturday and early Sunday while Stress rose from 92% to 97% as geopolitical headlines intensified during the weekend closure.
outlookSummary: Tail stays low through the Sunday closure, rises into WATCH as Globex approaches, and peaks at 24% in the reopening hour. Any 25%+ block state remains conditional on live persistent extension, weak retracements and corroborating cross-asset structure after trading resumes.
